original_ai_output.text:
The described lower right molar discomfort and gum tenderness may be consistent with localized irritation, inflammation, or a possible dental infection. Chewing sensitivity can occur when the area is inflamed or when there is an issue involving a tooth or surrounding gum tissue.

Because the person has not had a dental visit in over a year, the situation should be reviewed by a dental professional. Recent imaging and an examination would help clarify whether the symptoms are related to tooth structure, gum health, or another source of inflammation.

This draft should not be treated as a diagnosis or treatment recommendation.
